title: ConversationTurn
description:
One turn of conversation history carried by [`TurnDirective`].

`wyrd-spec` cannot depend on Skald, so the protocol's history shape is intentionally minimal: plain `{role, content}` text.

TurnRole.description:
Speaker role on a [`ConversationTurn`].

Tool and system roles stay inside the agent runtime layer; the eval protocol cares only about the user and agent dialogue.
